changes.title: ICC chief prosecutor Karim Khan removed from post over sexual misconduct allegations
changes.summary: The International Criminal Court voted to remove the global tribunal's chief prosecutor on Friday, nearly two years after sexual misconduct allegations against him first emerged, the court's oversight body announced.
